title: Split film
description: Two pictures or clips side by side, edge to edge: a thin gold line is drawn down the middle and the two halves open away from it (clip-path). Each half has a numbered label under the picture and a small title sits above. For a comparison, or for the same thing in two places. Nothing is drawn on the pictures; on a phone the halves are stacked.

props.left: required, {src, label, text, poster, alt, face}: a picture or a video (mp4/webm) and its label
props.right: required, the same for the other half
props.title: small heading above, 2-6 words
